purpose: Follow-up T4 tests recommended by research/audits/2026-10-25/FINDINGS.md
failure_rule: fail = WER(k) > max(0.125, WER(8) + 0.01) or SIM(k) < SIM(8) - 0.02 (core/failure_config.json)

policies.snr_only: Step 4 if prompt SNR >= 20 dB, else Step 8
policies.snr_drift_ltt: Definition 3.4 with lambda_hat from fixed-sequence LTT on the T4 calibration split (clean + noisy15, speaker fails if either fails)
policies.snr_drift_050: Definition 3.4 with lambda = 0.50 (the reports' CPU-label threshold)
policies.snr_step5: Step 5 if prompt SNR >= 20 dB, else Step 8

hypotheses.H1_heldout: On fresh speakers (clean + noisy15, speaker-level), snr_drift_ltt and snr_only each have realized risk with a 95% Clopper-Pearson interval reported against alpha = 0.05.
hypotheses.H2_drift_value: Per degradation condition, exact two-sided McNemar of snr_only vs snr_drift_050 failures on fresh speakers, Holm-adjusted across the nine conditions; drift adds value only if it has fewer failures with adjusted p < 0.05.
hypotheses.H3_seed_floor: Speaker-level rate at which Step 8 with seed B fails against Step 8 with seed A (test split, clean or noisy15), with a 95% Clopper-Pearson interval.

secondary: seed-A Step-8 reproducibility against the committed T4 grid (max abs WER and SIM difference)
development-evidence analyses on the committed T4 grid: calibrate on clean, test on noisy15; calibration size n = 50, 100, 200 (200 subsamples each, seed 2026)
